name: Scalenut
author: Scalenut

sections.description:
Scalenut’s Content Optimizer for WordPress helps you improve your SEO directly in the WordPress editor. Analyze your posts in real time
with an SEO score based on key ranking factors. Compare your content with top competitors on essential parameters like keywords, headings,
meta tags, keyword density, and links. Use actionable suggestions to optimize structure, featured snippets, and content depth for better rankings.

Key Features

  • Seamless Integration: Access Scalenut’s content analysis tools directly within the WordPress editor.
  • Create & Overwrite Reports: Generate new SEO reports or update existing ones with the latest data.
  • Comprehensive SEO Analysis: Get an SEO score and suggestions for improvement, including keyword usage, meta tags, headings, and more.
  • Content Optimization: Receive recommendations for keywords, meta tags, URLs, featured snippets, and content structure.
  • H1 & Featured Snippet Optimization: Ensure proper structure for H1 headings and featured snippets.
  • Content Depth & Link Building: Optimize word count, headings, images, and links for better SEO performance.
  • Keyword Density Insights: Maintain optimal keyword density for both primary and secondary keywords.

Boost your blog’s SEO performance with actionable insights and expert recommendations based on detailed analysis of your content within WordPress

How to Use

  1. Install the Scalenut Content Optimizer plugin from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. After activation, a new menu item named Scalenut will appear in the left sidebar of your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Click on Scalenut to access the plugin settings page.
  5. On the settings page, you will see an option to Login or Connect with your Scalenut account.
  6. Log in to your Scalenut account, or create one if you don’t have an existing account. You can also disconnect your account at any time from this page.
  7. Once the connection is successful, go to your posts and click the Scalenut button in the top-right corner.
  8. Attach the WordPress post with Scalenut by either creating a new SEO article or overwriting an existing Scalenut article.
  9. Once attached, start optimizing your content based on Scalenut’s SEO score and suggestions for improved performance.

Source Code

The non-minified source code for this plugin can be found at:
– GitHub: https://github.com/scalenut-app/scalenut-wordpress-plugin/tree/production

Service Explanation

Scalenut Content Optimizer uses API calls to our remote servers for processing and analyzing your blog content. These API calls are essential for generating the detailed SEO reports and optimization suggestions provided by the plugin.

  • Users need to create an account at Scalenut and obtain an API key to connect to the plugin.
  • The plugin sends the following data for processing:
    • Content data (text, images, URLs, and other metadata).
    • Keywords and content analysis results for generating SEO reports.

Once the data is processed, the plugin returns optimization insights including the SEO score, suggested keywords, meta tags, heading analysis, content depth, and keyword density. This helps users optimize their blog posts for higher SEO performance.

Data Handling

Scalenut Content Optimizer handles your content data securely and responsibly:

  1. The plugin sends content data, including text, images, meta information, and keywords, to Scalenut’s remote servers for processing.

  2. Our servers analyze the content using advanced algorithms to provide SEO reports, including:

    • SEO score and comparison with industry standards.
    • Suggested keywords and meta tags (powered by the Google Search API: https://www.google.com/complete/search).
    • Heading and content structure recommendations (H1, H2-H6, paragraphs, etc.).
    • Link recommendations, both internal and external.
    • Content depth suggestions (word count, image count, etc.).
    • Keyword density analysis for primary and secondary keywords.

  3. Keyword Suggestions: We use the Google Search API (https://www.google.com/complete/search) to provide suggested keywords based on actual search queries. This helps improve the relevancy and performance of the content in search engines.

All user data is processed in compliance with our policies:
– Privacy Policy
– Terms of Use

For more information about our services, visit:
– Scalenut Website

External Services

This plugin uses several third-party services to enhance its functionality. Below are the details:

  1. LottieFiles
    • What it is: LottieFiles is an animation and graphic service that provides interactive animations used in the plugin.
    • What data is sent and when: The plugin loads animations from LottieFiles’ CDN (https://assets1.lottiefiles.com) whenever a page with an animation is loaded. No personal user data is sent directly to LottieFiles.
    • Why it’s needed: The animations are used to enhance the visual appeal and interactivity of the plugin.

Additional Information

Support: If you encounter issues or need assistance, contact us at Scalenut Support.

Credits: This plugin is developed and maintained by the Scalenut team.

Disclaimer: This plugin requires an active internet connection to sync data with your Scalenut account. Please ensure your WordPress installation is configured for outgoing API requests.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Scalenut account to use this plugin?

Yes, a Scalenut account is required to connect and unlock the features of the plugin.

Is the plugin free to use?

Yes, the plugin is free to install and use.

Can I optimize existing content?

Absolutely! Scalenut helps you optimize both new and existing posts directly within WordPress.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Integrated Sentry for enhanced error tracking across the entire application.
  • Fixed issue where postId was getting null for some users due to editor loading errors.
  • Optimized login flow for improved performance and user experience.

1.0.1

  • Fixed an issue where secondary keywords were not processed correctly in the SEO analysis.
  • Minor performance improvements and code optimizations.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with core features including SEO report generation, keyword recommendations, and content optimization suggestions.
